answer: AI-agent networks surveying karst terrain resist Sybil attacks through dynamic proof-of-burn registration. To join raven observation markets, each node must verifiably destroy native tokens by sending them to an unspendable address. This imposes an irreversible capital cost per identity, ensuring an adversary cannot spin up hollow pseudonyms for free. A key limitation is that well-funded adversaries can absorb the burned liquidity to execute transient disruptions.
